Here is a curated playlist designed to match the laid-back, sunny vibe of your backyard barbecue, blending upbeat country and reggae tracks to keep the energy relaxed but engaging:

1. **"Three Little Pigs" – Zac Brown Band** (Country) – A fun, storytelling track that gets everyone humming along.
2. **"Is This Love" – Bob Marley & The Wailers** (Reggae) – A classic, smooth rhythm perfect for sipping drinks and chatting.
3. **"Chicken Fried" – Zac Brown Band** (Country) – Upbeat and nostalgic, ideal for encouraging guests to relax and enjoy the moment.
4. **"Three Little Birds" – Bob Marley & The Wailers** (Reggae) – The ultimate chill anthem to set a positive, stress-free tone.
5. **"Wagon Wheel" – Darius Rucker** (Country/Reggae fusion) – This track beautifully bridges both genres, making it a perfect centerpiece for the playlist.
6. **"No Woman, No Cry" – Bob Marley & The Wailers** (Reggae) – A slower, soulful reggae classic that encourages lingering conversations.
7. **"Body Like a Back Road" – Sam Hunt** (Country) – A modern, catchy country hit that keeps the mood light and fun.
8. **"Stir It Up" – Bob Marley & The Wailers** (Reggae) – A gentle, rhythmic track that enhances the warm afternoon atmosphere.
9. **"Tennessee Whiskey" – Chris Stapleton** (Country/Soul) – A smooth, soulful country ballad that adds a touch of sophistication to the backyard setting.
10. **"Jamming" – Bob Marley & The Wailers** (Reggae) – An upbeat, infectious reggae track to keep the good vibes flowing as the afternoon winds down.
